title: CapEx quick-triage: 1:1 prep notes (run-rate & procurement approvals)
content:
Goal: short prep for 1:1 with Mateo (Head of Finance). Primary objectives: validate near-term run-rate liabilities, decide on approval path for 3 pending buys, and agree a fast-track threshold for small pilots.

Snapshot (rough aggregated):
- Baseline monthly run-rate (committed recurring): $1.12M/mo (compute 61%, SaaS 18%, infra/ops 21%).
- Recent drift: Feb spike +$85k (burst GPUs + third-party data prep).
- Pending procurement asks (summary): total one-time ask ~$780k, plus incremental $6.5k/mo in support.

Pending items (short notes):
A) OptEdge Labs 10 Optimization suite + onboarding: $180k one-time + $3.5k/mo support.
   - Claim: 127% average per-token cost cut on our LLM pipelines; initial pilot for two models (chat + reranker).
   - Unknowns: sample size small, benchmarks provided on OptEdge infra.
   - Proposal: approve pilot at $75k capped, with vendor SLA to provide raw logs and reproducible runbook.

B) RackSpace-leased GPU tranche (6x H100-equivalent), 36-month lease: $520k commitment.
   - Upside: lowers hosted per-token variable cost and supports Dedicated bookings.
   - Downside: utilization risk, potential overcommit vs sales cadence.
   - Proposal: push procurement to offer 50% upfront capacity and option to purchase additional capacity at pre-negotiated rate after 120 days; require sublease permission to internal teams.

C) Integration partner 10 secure deploy + compliance packaging for regulated customer: $80k one-time.
   - Upside: runway to $1.2M ARR if delivered on schedule.
   - Risks: scope creep, acceptance criteria fuzzy.
   - Proposal: conditional approval tied to SOW with explicit milestones and holdback of final 25% until customer acceptance.

Run-rate sensitivity: if all approved as-is, near-term cash outflows hit ~$780k one-time and adds ~$3.5k/mo. CapEx buffer (FY25) sits at ~$1.9M so still within corridor but reduces runway for opportunistic hires or marketing spend.

Decision questions for Mateo:
- Are you comfortable delegating up to $75k one-time to me for rapid pilots? If yes, we can sign OptEdge pilot without VP escalation.
- Preference on leases: staged capacity vs full commit? Which risk tolerance do you want me to assume when negotiating?
- Do we want a standard procurement guardrail doc (1-pager) for any request between $75k00k to speed approvals?

Negotiation levers I will ask procurement/legal to pursue:
- Milestone-based payments for OptEdge, deliver raw logs + IP sandbox license for 60 days.
- For lease: phased delivery, conversion pricing cap, and internal sublease approval.
- For integration PS: SOW with acceptance tests and 25% holdback.

My recommended ask in meeting (concise):
- Approve OptEdge pilot at $75k cap, 45-day evaluation with kill clause.
- Approve integration PS conditional on SOW and 25% retention.
- Delay final sign-off on full GPU lease; approve 3 units now (half tranche) with 120d review and option to add rest.
- Ask Mateo to authorize delegation of up to $75k for pilots to avoid blocking cadence.

Materials to bring / actions before meeting:
- One-slide cost impact scenario (approve all vs staged) with monthly cashflow chart (Nate).
- Draft one-page approval memo template for mid-range asks (me).
- Vendor sample logs and customer refs from OptEdge (Clara).
- Lease vendor proposed contract w/ early-termination language (Procurement/legal).

Tone / logistics: clear ask, show guardrails and rollback options. Keep conversation to ~15 minutes and confirm next reviewer (VP or exec) if > $200k.

Notes-to-self:
- Mention cross-team sharing: platform-engineering may take excess GPU capacity on a time-limited basis.
- Suggest weekly procurement digest to finance execs while we clear the next 8 weeks of buys.
action_items: Clara: request OptEdge raw benchmark logs and two customer references (due 2026-03-02)
Nate: build 1-slide cashflow sensitivity (approve all vs staged) and attach numbers (due 2026-03-01)
Aisha: draft mid-range approval 1-pager template for $75k-$200k asks (due 2026-03-01)
Procurement/legal (via ticket): draft lease phased-delivery and sublease clause options (due 2026-03-03)
Aisha: prepare final one-slide recommended path for 1:1 (due 2026-03-04)
